claims.text: The dataset was created by validating each voice clip with at least two users to ensure quality.
Samples were filtered by sentence lengths to reduce short sentences, enhancing the dataset's quality.
The dataset includes a diverse range of speakers and accents, contributing to its robustness.
An additional evaluation corpus was collected from Tatoeba, adding more speech data.
